assumptions: The three routes and their required/optional parameters are the demo contract from spec §8.1, not confirmed server validation rules.
Unknown parameters are preserved and warned about, never treated as supported.
Known parameters outside a route's allowlist are errors under this local contract.
Custom amount selection does not emit focusOtherAmount: its applicability to these destination routes is unverified.
Preset amounts use the same local boundaries as custom amounts.
Campaign and internal labels are limited to 120 characters; this is a demo usability limit, not a server rule.

Dedication requires recipient name, recipient email and sender name in this builder; message is optional. Name/message length limits and basic email syntax checks are local policies, not verified server rules.
Dedication details are emitted only to choose-payment, the route in the supplied example. They are not presumed to prefill choose-dedication or propagate through choose-campaign.
